_about: Hand decisions layered on top of the Places Been export. build-data.py applies these after reading the CSV so a fresh export never undoes them. Decided by Nancy on 7 October 2026.
_country_rule_note: all_codes = every country code in the pins counts, territories and Kosovo included (94). Alternative values: un_only (87).

copy_to_collections._why: Nancy: 'I think of it as a park.' Zion is a designated US national park. The landmark pin stays, like Arches and Yellowstone.

unesco_from_landmarks._about: Landmark pins that sit inside an inscribed World Heritage property. Each becomes a UNESCO row using the pin's own coordinates. whc_id is the number in the official URL https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/<id>. Every row is marked confirm:true until Nancy checks it on whc.unesco.org; the report lists them.
